about: Banks for their own love life (dungeon/life/love_life.py): met (how they met, completing 'You met {partner} ...'), share_new (telling a friend they're seeing someone), dates (date-night posts), milestones (a post per step), splits (telling a friend about a breakup), spotted (another companion telling the user they saw {name} at {place} with someone else). {partner} is the partner's first name. In every bank but spotted, the partner's pronouns fill {they}, {them}, {their}, {theirs} and {themself} (capitalised: {They}, {Their}...), {they're} and {they've} ({They're}...), and the verb after them: {are}, {were}, {have}, {do} and {s} (a verb's 's': 'love{s}'). A they/them partner reads 'they' as before. tags: lines that fit only some cities or seasons (love_life.fitting): older (not in today's cities), modern (only in today's), cold (only in freezing months), warm (only in warm months); a line in no tag fits anywhere.
